situations.why: acceptance check 3 — a post-deadline submit must be rejected with 4xx
drafts must never appear in the public gallery or in judging
pending reviews must be exported as pending, never as zero
population sigma == 0 must yield z == 0 rather than a divide-by-zero
insufficient sample must fall back to neutral normalization
assignment coverage must report a judge with zero assignments
a judge must not read another track's protected judging data
the STALE Runbook state is demonstrable at boot without interaction
